cases.name: the printed cut widens from three to ten
cases.expect_survivor: Correct, and it is the measurement rather than a gap: both labelled rows' closing entries rank at 16 and nowhere, so they are outside a cut of 10 exactly as they are outside a cut of 3. A two-row labelled set cannot resolve the cut, which is what the rank measurement is for and what the RANKS docstring says. A third row ranked between 3 and 10 would make this mutation fail, and that is the number to move.
